description: Set Protocol powered TokenSets, an automated portfolio product from 2019-2021 where each strategy was an ERC-20 token backed by real collateral held in a shared vault. The TokenSets front end is gone, but the vault still holds the collateral and redemption is still open: burning a Set token returns its underlying share, unwrapped straight back to ETH.

meta.note: Three-level structure: user -> RebalancingSetToken -> collateral Set -> WETH in the Vault. Redeem with redeemRebalancingSetUnwrappingEther(rebalancingSet, quantity, false) on the RebalancingSetIssuanceModule; quantity must be a multiple of the RST's naturalUnit. Coverage is below 100% because some collateral Sets are held directly rather than through a RebalancingSetToken, and because holders below min_weth are dropped.
